messages.text: IF-009 as built, matching src/api/backupApi.ts: export -> 200 { fileName, directory, companies, diagnoses }; import -> 200 { imported: {companies, diagnoses}, skipped: {companies, diagnoses} } (your assumption for `skipped` is correct). Errors, all `{ error: { code, message } }`: 422 backup_invalid (generic message ending 'Nenhum dado foi alterado.'); 422 backup_newer_version with `rulesVersion` (message is the F-06 text 'O arquivo veio de uma versão mais nova do app (regras vN). Atualize o FitPulse pela loja do Play e tente de novo. Nenhum dado foi alterado.'); 413 payload_too_large above 10 MB; 400 invalid_json for text that is not JSON; 500 write_failed on export. `message` is ready to show in role="alert".

Behaviours the UI/e2e should know: (1) records whose id already exists here are skipped, never overwritten; diagnoses of an existing company are still added if their id is new. (2) A draft in the file is skipped (counted in skipped.diagnoses) when its company already has an open draft, keeping RULE-dm-13. (3) Export covers companies and diagnoses only (no preferences, per the plan). (4) Export normalises answers/calculator through readStoredAnswers/readStoredCalculator so the file always passes its own strict schema. (5) File name: fitpulse-copia-{local date}.json, ' (2)' suffix when it already exists.
